cross_cutting_findings.finding: Persistent state projected into prompts must remain bounded and provenance-linked; room objects are a useful state pattern but overlap existing world/body persistence work.
Fallback context such as geolocation must degrade to UNKNOWN rather than hard-coded plausible facts; otherwise tools silently fabricate world state.
Capability retirement requires topology/API/UI/prompt/schema parity; disabling or deleting only one surface leaves ghost architecture.

Adaptive adversarial multi-turn evaluation can reveal infrastructure selection pressure; the IAPT source specifically attributes template behavior to regex parsers, supporting production-context-parity testing.

Prompt-derived artifacts can recursively contaminate persistent topics/intents/training data and self-amplify. Data lineage must distinguish world evidence, generated projection, memory and learner admission.
A learner/safety critic is not healthy merely because it emits verdicts: every terminal accept/reject/suppress path needs outcome recording and class-support diagnostics.

Historical CI policy oscillated because different failure modes dominated at different times; current build policy should be capability/resource-conditioned and measured rather than copied from one historical snapshot.

anti_double_counting.rule: This shard closes semantic history obligations. Mechanisms overlapping existing PF prompt-contamination, state/persistence, context, learner, boot/capability and Retina lineages receive no duplicate hours.
